title: Network and Information Systems Regulations 2018
project_use: Current-law baseline where the fictional operator is assumed to fall within the applicable GB OES regime.

title: Ofgem NIS Guidance for Downstream Gas and Electricity Operators of Essential Services in GB, v3.0
project_use: Used for the GB OES assurance profile, including risk management, CAF assessment, improvement planning and assurance expectations.

title: NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework v4.0
project_use: Outcome-based assurance framework used to structure governance, protection, detection and response mappings.

title: Ofgem NIS Supplementary Guidance and CAF Overlay for the Downstream Gas and Electricity Sector
project_use: Adds sector context including Objective E for physical security and broader resilience concerns.

title: Cyber Security and Resilience (Network and Information Systems) Bill
project_use: Tracked for future change impact. It is not used as a current-law control requirement.
snapshot: 8 September 2026: House of Lords; next stage listed as report stage.

title: Directive (EU) 2022/2555 — NIS2
project_use: Energy-sector cybersecurity profile. Applicability depends on entity type, size rules, Member State implementation and factual activities.

title: Directive (EU) 2022/2557 — Critical Entities Resilience Directive
project_use: Broader all-hazards resilience profile where the operator is identified as a critical entity under national implementation.

title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1366
project_use: Electricity-sector cybersecurity reference only where the relevant entity is identified as high-impact or critical-impact under the Regulation.

title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 — Data Act
project_use: Used only for the later connected-product and related-service data analysis after roles and data flows are established.

title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 — Artificial Intelligence Act
project_use: Not part of the initial control test. It becomes relevant only if AI is introduced into a role that triggers the critical-infrastructure high-risk analysis.

title: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS
project_use: Used selectively to describe adversarial behaviour relevant to industrial control environments.
